parameters.name: weekStartPretty
parameters.label: Week start (pretty)
parameters.description: Pretty-formatted week start (e.g. "Aug 23, 2026") for the header's Week Of cell. The reference app prints prettyDate on both ends of the range, not the raw ISO dates.

parameters.name: weekEndPretty
parameters.label: Week end (pretty)
parameters.description: Pretty-formatted week end, printed under the start as "thru <date>".

parameters.name: calWeek
parameters.label: ISO calendar week
parameters.description: ISO calendar week of weekStart, for the header table's Cal. Wk. # column.

parameters.name: projectWeek
parameters.label: Project week number
parameters.description: 1-indexed week of weekStart relative to project.start_date, for the header table's Project Wk. # column. Em dash when start_date is unset. The reference app's weekly header carries Cal Wk / Project Wk, not a released-report count.

parameters.name: projectStartDate
parameters.label: Project start date (pretty)
parameters.description: Pretty-formatted copy of project.start_date for the header, so the weekly does not print a raw timestamp.

parameters.name: location
parameters.label: Site location
parameters.description: "City, ST" for the header's Location line, or null. The whole row is hidden when null, matching the reference app -- printing a bare comma is worse than omitting it.

parameters.name: narrativeSections
parameters.label: Narrative sections
parameters.description: Caller-resolved [{label, content}] -- only sections with a saved jfb_weekly_summaries entry for this week (mirrors the vanilla app's PDF: prints the PM's saved rollup, never the daily reference entries). Built by buildNarrativeSectionsParam() in weeklySummary.js.

parameters.name: weeklyProduction
parameters.label: Weekly production
parameters.description: Caller-computed, pre-formatted production figures for the week + project-to-date: {weekCy, weekSf, weekGoh, weekNoh, weekCyPerGoh, toDateCy, goal, pctComplete, hasPlan, plannedWeekCy, weekVariance, weekVariancePositive, plannedToDateCy, toDateVariance, toDateVariancePositive}. Sourced from dvw-jfb-realized-daily-totals-v2 (same per-day cy/sf/goh/noh rows the Realized To-Date report uses) and the project's cy_goh_goal/expected_goh_per_day production plan -- same planned = bid rate x expected GOH/day x production days definition as Realized To-Date. hasPlan/plannedX/variance fields are null when the project's production plan isn't set.

parameters.name: weeklyDelayRowsLeft
parameters.label: Weekly delay breakdown (left column)
parameters.description: Caller-computed [{description, hours, pct, barPct}] from dvw-jfb-realized-delay-summary-v2, scoped to this week's date range, sorted descending by hours and split into left/right halves (Math.ceil(length/2)) for the 2-column bar chart. barPct is the bar width as a percent of the single largest delay code's hours, matching the reference app's WeeklySummaryDocument.tsx delay chart exactly (itself the same pattern as RealizedToDateDocument.tsx / native's own realizedPdfData.js delayRowsLeft/Right).

parameters.name: weeklyDelayTotalHours
parameters.label: Total delay hours this week
parameters.description: Sum of all delay hours this week, shown in the bar chart's bold Total row (no bar).

parameters.name: unit
parameters.label: Primary measure unit
parameters.description: project.primary_measure (e.g. "CY"), caller-resolved so the production labels match the project's unit.

parameters.name: weeklyPhotoAssets
parameters.label: Weekly photo assets
parameters.description: Caller-resolved {"1": {label, dataUri}|undefined, "2": {...}|undefined}, one per uploaded jfb_weekly_summary_photos slot for this week. Resolved client-side via downloadAttachment() + base64 data-URI conversion, same pattern as the daily report's photoAssets.

parameters.name: hasWeeklyPhotos
parameters.label: Has weekly photos
parameters.description: True when at least one weekly photo slot holds an image. The whole Site Photos band and frame row is skipped when false, matching the reference app's hasPhotos gate -- a week with no photos prints no empty frames.

parameters.name: weeklyChartAssets
parameters.label: Weekly dredge chart images
parameters.description: Caller-resolved [{label, dataUri}], one per dredge with saved progress coverage this week or before (renderWeeklyProgressCharts). One PDF page is appended per entry; omitted or empty for non-dredge projects or weeks with no coverage yet.

parameters.name: weeklyDelayRowsRight
parameters.label: Weekly delay breakdown (right column)
parameters.description: Right-column half of the same delay rows as weeklyDelayRowsLeft -- see that parameter for the full shape/description.

parameters.name: hasWeeklyDelays
parameters.label: Has weekly delays
parameters.description: True when at least one delay-coded row exists this week; gates the bar chart vs. the "No delay-coded activity this week" empty state.

parameters.name: generatedDate
parameters.label: Generated date
parameters.description: Caller-formatted date the PDF was generated, printed in the production footnote. Pre-formatted client-side so it reads in the same style as the rest of the report.
